sourceEvidence.quote:
# Supply Chain Manager, Electrode
| Job Category | Supply Chain |
| Location | Palo Alto, California |
| Req. ID | 288504 |
| Job Type | Full-time |
**What to Expect**
Supply Chain Manager, Electrodes is a strategic thinker with a proven track record of demand planning, engineering and development collaboration, and experience in managing complex supply chains. The GSM will work to develop supply chains for Cathode and Anode Electrode.
In this role the GSM will be responsible for contracting capacity, developing should cost models, negotiating best in class pricing and contracts, all the way from R&D to production, while balancing cost, quality standards, global supply and demand, as well as geopolitical risks.
Tesla is a fast-moving, dynamic environment where flexibility and adaptability are key attributes needed for success. The successful candidate will be a self-starter; motivated with a demonstrated track record of achievement.
**What You’ll Do**
* Negotiate commercial agreements with supply chain partners. For eg GTC, PPA, License agreements, MTA, etc.
* Manage supplier relationships to get the best deals for the company
* Conduct market analysis to identify new suppliers and partnerships opportunities
* Lead large-scale supplier investment projects from idea to implementation
* Lead make v/s buy investigations, develop and execute long term sourcing strategies based on these analysis
* Owner of RFI's, RFP's and RFQ's - ensuring all commercial terms are agreed and documented
* Develop and utilize cost models to define should costs and negotiate price for sourcing and cost reduction
* Analyze current market conditions, technology roadmaps, and identify supply/demand challenges & opportunities
* Lead the vendor selection process with engineering teams, including raw material specification, vendor technology and capabilities assessment, and alternative product options
* Oversee demand planning and forecasting to ensure production lines remain at capacity
**What You’ll Bring**
* Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of work experience in Engineering, Supply chain Management, or Management Consulting role
* Ability to make decisions based on limited information
* Prior experience with Batteries, Battery Materials preferred
* Dedication to the Tesla mission of accelerating the transition to renewable energy
* Ability to thrive in a fast paced, highly dynamic environment
* Excellent team building skills in dealing with suppliers, peers, and other functional teams
* Strong writing ability and an ability to explain complex issues in a concise and plain manner
* Willingness to travel up to 30%
**Compensation and Benefits**
Benefits
Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
Expected Compensation
$104,000 - $192,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
